Programa de Apoyo al Desarrollo de la Industria de Hidrgeno Verde en Chile

description.narrative: El objetivo general de desarrollo de esta segunda operacin individual es contribuiral desarrollo de la industria del Hidrgeno Verde (H2V) y sus derivados en Chile para contribuir a la descarbonizacin desu economa. Los objetivos especficos de desarrollo son: (i) promover la inversin privada en proyectos de H2V y susderivados; y (ii) aumentar la oferta de Insumos Pblicos (IP) para la industria de H2V y sus derivados, y fomentar lademanda domstica de estos productos. La presente operacin es la segunda operacin individual bajo la CCLIPCH-O0008 aprobada mediante resolucin DE-14222.

The general development objective of this second individual operation is to contribute to the development of the Green Hydrogen (H2V) industry and its derivatives in Chile to contribute to the decarbonization of its economy. The specific development objectives are: (i) to promote private investment in H2V projects and its derivatives; and (ii) to increase the supply of Public Input (PI) for the H2V industry and its derivatives, and to promote domestic demand for these products. The present operation is the second individual operation under CCLIPCH-O0008 approved by resolution DE-14222.
